channel.title: Aviation, shipping & logistics · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Aviation, shipping & logistics in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−1.3).

item.title: [−2] Hormuz hit by the worst attacks of the war as flows plunge; US threatens to 'hit Iran hard'
item.description:
Two more ship strikes were reported overnight. Brent settled 0.9% lower at $105.69 on Monday, but analysts warn a closure could lift oil to $130. Escalating.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: headwind (−2) — Freight and insurance

Why it matters: A full closure would sharply lift crude, LNG and freight costs for India, widening the import bill and pushing inflation and the rupee further.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Shipping a cargo of Russian oil to India now costs up to $30 million as freight hits records
item.description:
Freight for Russian Urals shipments to India hit fresh records in early October, and supertanker rates hit a record on the Hormuz blockade. Cheap US crude is piling up for lack of tankers. Escalating.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild tailwind (+1) — Tanker owners earn more

Why it matters: Record freight wipes out much of the discount on Russian crude and raises India's landed oil cost, widening the import bill and squeezing refiners.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Rupee −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Saudi-led coalition strikes oil facilities near Sanaa as the Red Sea war escalates
item.description:
Follows Houthi strikes on Saudi airports and threats to Saudi tankers. Escalating.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild headwind (−1) — Red Sea route risk

Why it matters: A wider Saudi–Houthi war threatens India's main non-Hormuz crude supplier and the Red Sea route for Indian exports to Europe.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Ukraine says it has not struck Russian refineries for two days under the US energy ceasefire
item.description:
An Indian worker was killed in an earlier strike on a Russian refinery. The pause follows US pressure on both sides. Easing, but fragile.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild tailwind (+1) — Softer diesel prices

Why it matters: A lasting halt to refinery strikes would steady Russian fuel exports, softening diesel prices and India's fuel costs.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
